caption: Dempsey Motors, recently retired by the proprietor. A local trucking business has secured planning permission to redevelop the site with a state-of-the-art HQ and new offices. A really exciting upgrade in the pipeline for this end of the village (May 2026)

Our blue trough planter at the Dempsey Motors site, planted up with red Geum, ornamental grass and a mix of perennials. Even with the redevelopment coming we keep the planters in flower so the spot stays welcoming (May 2026)
